title: Recent Nonpayment Cancellation: Relativity on a Named Non-Owner Policy DUI Realignment
content:
When a Named Non-Owner Policy term is realigned to Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50 for a DUI requirement, a recent cancellation of the term for nonpayment carries a relativity on the re-rated full-term premium.

**Reading the cancellation.** A cancellation for nonpayment recorded on the term is read from the nonpayment cancellation return booked on its premium ledger — the latest by processing date, the one recorded first when two share it. The months are counted in whole months from that return's effective date, the cancellation effective date, to the day of the change, a month being complete on the same day of the following month.

| Whole months from the cancellation effective date | Relativity |
|---|---|
| fewer than 3 (0, 1 or 2) | 1.08 |
| 3 to 5 | 1.04 |
| 6 or more | none |
| no nonpayment cancellation return on the ledger | none |

The relativity multiplies the re-rated full-term premium before that figure is rounded to the cent.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical; cancellation effective 14 January).**

| The day of the change | Whole months | Relativity |
|---|---|---|
| 13 April | 2 | 1.08 |
| 14 April | 3 | 1.04 |
| 13 July | 5 | 1.04 |
| 14 July | 6 | none |
